evidence.finding: 12-case geomean 0.9972x. Small/mid cases (1024-1048576 elems) cluster 0.92-0.97x at a ~14.7-16us full-call floor (host bound, kernel tiny); large bf16 4096x4096 is worst at 0.815x (23.57 vs 19.22us), while large fp16 is 1.485x and fp32 1.002x. The dominant reusable loss is per-call host dispatch on the many small cases, not the single bf16 device case.

run() performs device/shape/contiguity/numel guard work unconditionally: out.get_device() vs input.get_device(), out.shape!=input.shape, out.is_contiguous(), input.is_contiguous(), input.numel(), even when out was freshly allocated by torch.empty_like(..., contiguous_format) so shape/device/contiguity are known true by construction. The compiled launcher is already cached in _FAST/_PLANS and launched with dynamically-read integer pointers and current stream.

Historical host sampling: run plus _run_one self-time ~9.71us/call; flat contiguous path can use a light key while non-contiguous keeps full layout identity. Must not cache pointers, tensors, or old stream; dynamic device/pointer/stream are re-read each call. Confirms host-side dispatch is the lever and that guards on user-provided layout must stay.

Public ABI run(input, *, decimals=0, out=None). Must keep optional out allocation, resize on shape mismatch, cross-device ValueError, and exact numerical/special-value behavior. This edit only elides guard work that is provably implied by our own allocation.

hypothesis: When out is None we allocate a contiguous, same-shape, same-device tensor, so the shape/resize check, cross-device check, and out.is_contiguous() check are trivially satisfied. Hoisting input.get_device() into one local and skipping these provably-redundant checks on the fresh-allocation branch (while leaving every guard intact on the user-supplied out branch, and the fast launcher/kernel unchanged) reduces per-call host dispatch and raises full-call throughput on small/mid inputs without touching correctness or numerics.
change: Edit only candidate.py run(): compute device once, branch on fresh out; on fresh branch allocate and skip implied shape/device/out-contiguity checks; keep resize_/cross-device ValueError and out.is_contiguous() for provided out; reorder the fast-path guard to reject cheaply. No kernel, launcher ABI, or _slow/_build changes.
expected: Small/mid full-call latency drops by the removed guard-call overhead (target ~0.3-1us of ~15us); large-input cases unchanged. Semantics identical for out=None and out-provided paths.
validation: Preflight (compile + supplementary semantics) must pass; then full KGS formal timing compared against the 0.9971932405x baseline. Confirm resize/device-raise behavior and special values still hold.
